user.title: Add a Hommyn device
user.description:
In the Hommyn app, open the device, tap **Share device**, and copy the `rusklimat://...` link. Paste it below.

Supported device types: {supported}

error.invalid_share_link: This doesn't look like a valid Hommyn share link. Expected something starting with `rusklimat://device-share/...`.
